description: This file defines the interface IController within the WPEFramework::PluginHost namespace. It declares several pure virtual methods related to control operations such as Persist, Delete, Reboot, Environment, Configuration, and Clone. It also includes licensing information, include directives, and namespace encapsulation.

classes.name: IController
classes.description: An interface for device or plugin control operations, providing methods for persistence, deletion, rebooting, environment retrieval, configuration management, and cloning.

methods.name: Persist
methods.description: Persist the current state or configuration.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Delete a specified resource identified by a path.

methods.name: Environment
methods.description: Retrieve environment information based on an index.

methods.name: Configuration
methods.description: Retrieve or set configuration for a given callsign.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Create a clone with a new callsign from a base callsign.
